# Changelog

## 1.3.0
- New tab **Solo**: several characters for one player, rebuilt inside the menu (replaces the stand-alone Solo mod).
- **Facce**: the photo folder can be chosen from the menu and can be anywhere on disk.
- The menu window can be dragged by its title bar; its position is remembered.
- Installer: choose which mods to install; re-running it updates and adds, never removes.
- No personal photos are shipped.

## 1.2.0
- New tabs **Voce** (per-player voice volume) and **Reshade** (bloom, tone, sharpening).
- **Prestazioni**: FOV, antialiasing mode, upscaling filter, shadow cascades/resolution, soft shadows, anisotropic filtering, wider render scale and LOD ranges.

## 1.1.0
- Sharing your look, face, emotes and speech bubbles with friends who run the mod.

## 1.0.0
- First version: Generale, Facce, Personaggio, Telecamera, Prestazioni, Mondo, Extra, Replay.
